effect.minecraft.trial_omen.description: Transforms nearby trial spawners into ominous trial spawners. Last 15 minutes tiles le levels of le original Bad Omen effet
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.description: Starts a raid à le location le effet was gained, once le effet expires. Lasts 30 secondes.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.descriptio: Fait affected entités emit a burst of wind sur mort.
effect.minecraft.weaving.description: Fait affected entités spread cobweb blocs upon mort.
effect.minecraft.oozing.description: Fait affected entités apparaître two slimes upon mort.
effect.minecraft.infested.description: Donne affected entités a 10% chance à apparaître between 1 et 2 silverfish lorsque hurt.
effect.apothic_attributes.grievious.desc: Réduit healing received par 20% each level.
effect.apothic_attributes.vitality.descr: Augmente healing received par 20% each level.
effect.deeperdarker.sculk_affinity.descr: Masks all sons le joueur emits so Sculk Sensors peut no longer pick them up. Does pas masque sons emitted par e.g. pets ou lâché objets!
effect.dungeons_mobs.ensnared.descriptio: Affected entités sont trapped dans placer.
effect.dungeons_mobs.warped.description: Inflicts lethal magie dégâts over time.
effect.dungeons_gear.stunned.description: Stuns an entité, causing nausea et slowing their movement. Higher levels augmenter le stun chance.
effect.dungeons_gear.party_starter.descr: Melee attacks va cause entités à explode.
effect.dungeons_gear.dynamo.description: Augmente dégâts sur next attaque, higher levels augmenter le dégâts boost.
effect.dungeons_gear.life_steal.descript: Steals vie de entités killed, higher levels augmenter le amount of vie stolen.
effect.dungeons_gear.bow_charge.descript: Le next ranged attaque va automatically be fully charged.
effect.farmersdelight.nourishment.descri: Prevents hunger loss, except lorsque en utilisant saturation à heal dégâts.
effect.goodending.strong_immunity.descri: Strong immunity retire a harmful effet, then downgrades à contemporary immunity.
Contemporary immunity retire a harmful effet, then downgrades à shattered immunity.
effect.goodending.shattered_immunity.des: Shattered immunity retire a harmful effet, then dissipates.
effect.habitat.prickling,description: Has a chance à deal thorns dégâts equal à its level à le attacker.
effect.habitat.prolongation.description: Augmente le duration of all incoming potion effets par 20%.
effect.species.wither_resistance.descrip: Accorde immunity à le Wither effet.
effect.species.birtd.description: Stuns le afflicted et prevents them de moving, mais pas fighting back.
effect.mynethersdelight.b_pungent.descri: Deals feu dégâts lorsque near a chaleur source.  Heals instead si vous aussi have feu resistance.
effect.mynethersdelight.g_pungent.descri: Heals de chaleur sources lorsque combined avec feu resistance.  Deals dégâts instead sans it.
effect.enigmaticlegacy.growing_hunger.de: Drains hunger over time,  mais accorde increased dégâts et life steal.
effect.enigmaticlegacy.growing_bloodlust: Drains vie over time, mais accorde increased dégâts et life steal.  Only applied si le bearer of le curse has eaten le forbidden fruit.
effect.mowziesmobs.sunblock.description: Le Umvuthana sont protecting their chief!  Stop them before vous're overwhelmed!
